name: Clever Critter
body:
You are smarter than the average animal.

Prerequisite: Animal Intelligence (1 or 2)

Benefit: As a genius among animals, your Intelligence is 2 points higher than normal. You understand simple statements and questions spoken in the language of your trainer, if you have one. You also have some intuitive understanding of the basic motivations of civilized races and the purpose of their most basic tools.

Special: This feat may be taken by animals.

Note: This feat effectively grants the animal an additional skill point when it gains HD and allows it to learn any feat it can physically perform.
